findings.title: A bad --format blocks a later valid one
findings.description: `render --format yaml --format json` exits 2 because the `--format` branch in `src/cli.ts` validates each value as it is read, so the later valid `json` is never used. Any consumer that sets a default format and then overrides it gets an error instead of the JSON requested, which conflicts with the repeated-options rule, and the author has chosen to keep this behaviour, so this is a decision for the team rather than a clear bug.

citations.citation: CLI format selection and backward compatibility
Reject invalid CLI formats before reading stdin

evidence.explanation: Rule 4578702 requires that repeated options use the last value, and its failure criterion is that repeated options do not use the last value. The loop in `src/cli.ts` rejects `yaml` on the first pass, so the last value `json` is never used. Rule 4578703 requires invalid values to be rejected before stdin is read, which the current code does, so the two rules conflict for this input. The author's notes record that the user chose not to change this, so the finding is only remediation_recommended.

review_agent_comment: One optional documentation clarification: `NotesCounts.total` excludes malformed records, so “Parsed input commits” may be clearer than “Input commits” and avoid implying that `shown + ignored + malformed === total`.
